snippets.title: Assembly Fibonacci Sequence
snippets.code:
org 100h  ; Program baslangici

mov cx, 10     ; Fibonacci dizisinde yazilacak eleman sayisi (ornek: 10)
mov ax, 0      ; ilk Fibonacci sayisi: F(0) = 0
mov bx, 1      ; ikinci Fibonacci sayisi F(1) = 1

; Bellekte sonuclari saklamak icin baslangic adresi belirleme
mov di, 2000h  ; Fibonacci dizisi 2000h adresine yazilacak

; İlk iki sayiyi bellege yaz
mov [di], ax   ; F(0) = 0
add di, 2      ; Bir sonraki bellek adresine gec
mov [di], bx   ; F(1) = 1
add di, 2      ; Bir sonraki bellek adresine gec

; Fibonacci Hesaplama Dongusu
fib_loop:
dec cx         ; cx = cx - 1, eleman sayisini azalt
jz done        ; cx 0 olursa islemi bitir

; Fibonacci hesaplama: Fn = F(n-1) + F(n-2)
mov dx, ax     ; dx = F(n-2)
add ax, bx     ; ax = F(n-1) + F(n-2)
mov bx, dx     ; bx = eski F(n-1)

; Yeni Fibonacci sayisini bellege yaz
mov [di], ax   ; Bellege Fibonacci sayisini yaz
add di, 2      ; Bellekte bir sonraki adrese gec
jmp fib_loop   ; Donguyu tekrar baslat

done:
int 20h        ; Program bitir

snippets.title: Assembly Memory Initialization and Summation
snippets.code:
org 100h                    ; Program starting address

; Initialization
mov ax, 2000h              ; Data segment address
mov ds, ax                 ; Set DS to 2000h

mov N, 5                   ; Initialize N = 5 (can be changed during the lab)
mov M, 3                   ; Initialize M = 3 (can be changed during the lab)

; Memory Initialization Loop
mov cx, N                  ; CX = N, counter for memory initialization
mov di, 0                  ; Offset (starts at DS:[2000h])
mov al, 1                  ; AL = starting value (1)

init_loop:
    mov [di], al          ; Store AL at DS:[2000h + di]
    inc al                ; Increment AL (next integer)
    inc di                ; Move to the next memory address
    loop init_loop        ; Repeat until CX = 0

; Double N After M Iterations
mov cx, M                  ; CX = M, counter for doubling
double_loop:
    loop double_loop      ; Wait for M iterations
    shl N, 1              ; Double N (N = N * 2)

; Summation Loop
mov cx, N                  ; CX = N, counter for summation
mov di, 0                  ; Offset for DS:[2000h]
xor ax, ax                ; Clear AX (sum accumulator)

sum_loop:
    add al, [di]          ; Add value at DS:[2000h + di] to AL
    inc di                ; Move to the next memory address
    loop sum_loop         ; Repeat until CX = 0

mov [di], ax              ; Store sum at DS:[2000h + N]

; Print Values (Bonus)
mov cx, N                  ; CX = N, counter for printing
mov di, 0                  ; Offset for DS:[2000h]
call print_values         ; Call print function to display values

; Terminate Program
mov ah, 4Ch
int 21h

; Print Function
print_values:
    mov ah, 2
print_loop:
    mov dl, [di]          ; Load value from memory into DL
    int 21h               ; Print DL
    inc di                ; Move to the next memory address
    loop print_loop       ; Repeat until CX = 0
    ret                   ; Return to caller

N db 0                    ; Define N variable
M db 0                    ; Define M variable
